notes.title: BAKI HANMA BLOOD ARENA IS HERE!
notes.content:
Step into the brutal world of Baki Hanma, inspired by the legendary Netflix anime. With explosive special moves, intense 2D combat, and relentless battles, this is the ultimate test of strength.

💥 What to Expect:
🥊 Precision-based fighting mechanics, inspired by Super Punch-Out!!
💀 Face iconic fighters, each with their own unique combat style
⚡ Unleash devastating special attacks straight from the anime
🎵 Immerse yourself in an original soundtrack capturing the raw energy of Baki’s world

💪 Are you ready to fight your way to the top?

🔗 Wishlist now and prepare for battle! → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469230
